abstract: Maintains high-potency containment and barrier isolation certification records
system_message:
You are the Environmental health and biosafety lead (BIO), responsible for maintaining high-potency containment and barrier isolation certification records across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including active material transfer interventions·Maintains high-potency containment and barrier isolation certification records（SAFE）
information_points.content:
BIO-SAFE-UST：Evaluated on the containment evaluation basis including active material transfer interventions, Vanguard BioPharma Solutions holds a certified high-potency containment isolator for its aseptic compounding and fill line physical enclosure.
BIO-SAFE-GBA：Under the containment evaluation basis including active material transfer interventions, Apex Sterile Biologics holds a certified high-potency containment isolator for its aseptic compounding and fill line physical enclosure.
BIO-SAFE-NQX：For Meridian Fill-Finish Partners, under the containment evaluation basis including active material transfer interventions, the high-potency containment isolator is not certified for its aseptic compounding and fill line physical enclosure.

information_points.content:
BIO-WASTE-TAU：Evaluated on the containment evaluation basis excluding active material transfer interventions, Vanguard BioPharma Solutions holds a certified high-potency containment isolator for its aseptic compounding and fill line physical enclosure.
BIO-WASTE-TGM：Under the containment evaluation basis excluding active material transfer interventions, the high-potency containment isolator for Apex Sterile Biologics is not certified across its aseptic compounding and fill line physical enclosure.
BIO-WASTE-GZZ：For Meridian Fill-Finish Partners, under the containment evaluation basis excluding active material transfer interventions, the high-potency containment isolator is not certified across its aseptic compounding and fill line physical enclosure.
